defects.description: The glossary term 'disk quota' ('дисковая квота') is used incorrectly and is grammatically wrong in the heading.
The glossary term 'disk quota' ('дисковая квота') is replaced by 'квоты дисков' or 'квоты для дисков'.
The glossary term 'disk quota' ('дисковая квота') is replaced by 'квот дискового пространства'.
Mixed language in the reference title; 'Kernel' is translated to 'Ядро' while the rest of the title remains in English.
Incorrect grammatical case (nominative instead of genitive) and unnecessary bolding.
